KursplanLäsår25/2626/27
Course syllabus
Introduction to Programming
Programmering, grundkurs
EDAB05, 10.5 credits, G1 (First Cycle)

Valid for: 2026/27
Faculty: Faculty of Engineering LTH
Decided by: PLED C/D
Date of Decision: 2026-04-16
    
  
General Information

Main field:  Technology
      
      
        Depth of study relative to the degree requirements:  First cycle, in-depth level of the course cannot be classified
      
      
Mandatory for: C1, D1
Language of instruction: The course will be given in Swedish
    
  
Aim
The students shall learn to write small and medium-sized computer programs and attain basic knowledge of imperative programming, object-orientation and functional programming and software development tools that are useful during their continued education.
Learning outcomes
Knowledge and understanding
      For a passing grade the student must
be able to explain fundamental concepts in imperative programming, object-orientation and functional programmingbe able to explain and give examples of use of simple algorithmsbe able to describe and give examples of use of common data types for collections, such as sequences, sets and mapsknow about different software development tools and basic computer usage, such as terminal, file systems, version management, type setting tools, and basic understanding of the relation between source code and machine code
Competences and skills
      For a passing grade the student must
be able to develop and implement algorithms to solve simple problemsbe able to implement classes from given requirementsbe able to structure programs, using classes and methodsbe able to use several different tools to write, test and debug programsbe able to use several different software development tools, such as the Linux terminal, LaTeX, Git, software repositories
Judgement and approach
      For a passing grade the student must
be able to estimate the degree of difficulty of writing different programsbe able to judge difficulties and advantages with mutable versus immutable databe able to evaluate pros and cons of different software development tools and assess their utility 
Contents
Basic programming constructs and construction of simple algorithms. Usage of common data types for collections: sequences, sets, maps. Basic object-orientation: object, class, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, immutable objects, mutable state. The Linux terminal, typesetting with LaTeX, introduction to version management with Git, machine code programming. Scala is used as the main programming language.

For higher grades, a written exam is also required. To be allowed to write the exam (for grades 4 or 5), all criteria for passing must be met.

Credits: 4.5. Grading scale: UG - (U, G).
        
          Assessment: The compulsory laboratory work must be completed to qualify for a passing grade.
